props.gloss_en: ten things were said of the cup of blessing
it requires rinsing and washing
[it must be] undiluted and full
adorning and wrapping
he takes it in his two hands
and places it in the right [hand]
and he lifts it a handbreadth from the ground
and he sets his eyes on it
some say: he also sends it as a gift to the members of his household
R' Yochanan: we have only four -- rinsing, washing, undiluted and full
rinsing is on the inside
and washing is on the outside
R' Yochanan: whoever blesses over a full cup is given an inheritance without bounds
as it is said: 'and full of the blessing of the Lord, possess the sea and the south' (Deut 33:23)
R' Yosei bar Chanina: he merits and inherits two worlds, this world and the world to come
Rav Yehuda adorns it with students
Rav Chisda adorns it with cups
R' Chanan: and with undiluted [wine]
Rav Sheshet: and at the blessing of the land
Rav Pappa wraps himself and sits
Rav Asi spreads a cloth over his head
R' Chinnana bar Pappa: what is the verse? -- 'lift up your hands in holiness and bless the Lord' (Ps 134:2)
R' Yochanan: the early ones asked -- may the left [hand] assist the right?
Rav Ashi: since the early ones raised it and it was not resolved for them, we act stringently [the left does not assist the right]
Rav Acha b'R' Chanina: what is the verse? -- 'I will lift up the cup of salvation and call upon the name of the Lord' (Ps 116:13)
he sets his eyes on it -- so that his mind not be diverted from it
he sends it as a gift to his household -- so that his wife be blessed
Ulla came to Rav Nachman's house; he ate bread, said Grace after Meals, and gave the cup of blessing to Rav Nachman
Rav Nachman: let the master send the cup of blessing to Yalta
R' Yochanan (as Ulla reports him): the fruit of a woman's womb is blessed only from the fruit of a man's womb
as it is said: 'and He will bless the fruit of your womb' (Deut 7:13) -- 'the fruit of her womb' is not said, but 'the fruit of your [masc.] womb'
R' Natan: whence that the fruit of a woman's womb is blessed only from the fruit of a man's womb?
Yalta heard, rose in anger, went into the wine-store and broke four hundred jars of wine
Rav Nachman: let the master send her another cup
Ulla's message: all of this jug is [wine] of blessing
Yalta's reply: from peddlers -- words, and from rags -- lice
Rav Asi: one does not converse over the cup of blessing
and Rav Asi: one does not bless over a cup of punishment
what is 'a cup of punishment'? Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: a second cup
the baraita: one who drinks in pairs should not bless
because it is said 'prepare to meet your God, O Israel' (Amos 4:12) -- and this one is not prepared
one who eats while walking blesses standing
and when he eats standing, he blesses sitting
and when he reclines and eats, he sits and blesses
and the halakha: in all of them he sits and blesses
